name: deploy
description: Publishes the site's static export to a hosting service with the workspace's own saved credentials. Ships the host code itself (Tovu loads it only because Tovu shipped it) and the know-how an agent needs: which host fits the person, where to get a token, preview before publishing, and what each failure means in plain words. Netlify first; more hosts move in here one at a time.
author: Tovu
